title: The Sorcerer's Broken Tree
description: A hooded purple-robed sorcerer stands on a black and white checkered floor holding an open book titled 'BOOK OF SPELLS' while casting magic toward a large cracked glass cylinder. Inside the cylinder, a dark gnarled tree with a large central eye and multiple smaller eyes burns with bright orange flames; a large dark phoenix with red-tipped wings perches on top of the cylinder while blue glowing birds fly around the scene.
prompt: A hooded sorcerer in a flowing purple starry robe stands on a checkered floor holding the Book of Spells, casting magic at a giant cracked purple glass cylinder. Inside the cylinder grows a dark gnarled tree with a large central green eye and smaller eyes on its trunk, engulfed in bright orange flames. A large dark phoenix with fiery red wing tips perches on the cylinder's rim while several glowing blue birds fly around it. A cracked moon hangs in the purple and green sky, fantasy illustration style, vibrant and surreal.
